verification.selector: Per-lane artifact registry, manifest integration, and scoped extension suite
Focused full eighteen-lane build, compatibility, and forensic audit
Python lint, compile, artifact-registry JSON, and whitespace validation
verification.result: Ruff, py_compile, json.tool, and git diff --check passed

negative_cases: A required extension authority or active conditional artifact cannot be absent.
An inactive conditional or optional artifact may be absent, but any present file is hash- and size-bound.
Undeclared extension files, duplicate roles or paths, unsafe IDs, traversal, path escape, symlinks, and core overrides fail closed.
Tampering with a declared extension file invalidates the recomputed lane projection.
Adding a validated extension to one lane leaves another lane's projection byte-identical.
Historical manifests without the additive artifact projection remain compatible and cannot fabricate a modern enforced receipt.
limitations: Row214 supplies the lane-local registry, compiler, projection, and validator; public SDK/MCP/skill routes for requesting extensions remain queued.
The contract is additive inside the established v3 lane manifest because changing the separate forensic-audit schema belongs outside this Delta.
Query path guidance and execution budgets remain Rows215-218; schema migrations remain governed by the completed Row213 engine.
next_boundary: Close Row214 through its exact per-Delta checkpoint. Row215 EL-CODEX-T6-PARITY-018-LANE-QUERY-GUIDANCE owns the authoritative bounded lane-query workflow, exact path templates, result limits, and provenance rules.
